map.功率因数（本页代码口径）：PF=有功功率 P÷视在功率 S（即 cosφ）；相位: Power factor (as implemented on this page): PF = active power P ÷ apparent power S (i.e. cosφ); phase angle φ = arccos(PF) × 180 ÷ π (°); related values: apparent minus active = S − P, reactive power Q = S × sin(arccos(PF)) (kvar). Validation: both fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise prompt and stop. Criteria: no fixed grading; the closer PF is to 1, the smaller the reactive share, and at PF = 1, Q = 0 and φ = 0°.
map.PF 低需无功补偿。: A low PF requires reactive power compensation.
map.评估无功补偿需求降低基本电费。: Assess the reactive power compensation need to reduce the basic electricity cost.
map.电机就地补偿提升 PF 减少线损。: Local compensation at motors raises the PF and reduces line loss.
map.理解力率调整电费奖惩。: Understand the power factor adjustment electricity fee rewards/penalties.
map.负载有功 80 kW、三相 380 V、PF 0.7、目标 0.95：视在电流由: Active load 80 kW, three-phase 380 V, PF 0.7 to 0.95: apparent current drops from 80/(√3×0.38×0.7)≈174 A to 80/(√3×0.38×0.95)≈128 A, and I²R line loss drops to (128/174)²≈54%; meeting PF also avoids power-factor penalties. Note: capacitor compensation must prevent over-compensation and resonance.
map.低功率因数有什么坏处？: What are the disadvantages of a low power factor?
map.同有功下电流更大，线损与压降上升、变压器/线路容量被无功占用，供电方常收力率罚款: For the same active power, the current is larger, raising line loss and voltage drop; transformer/line capacity is occupied by reactive power, and the supplier often charges a power factor penalty.
map.感性负载（电机）并联电容或 SVG 就地补偿；变频器/整流负载用有源滤波兼补偿。: Connect capacitors in parallel with inductive loads (motors) or use local SVG compensation; for VFD/rectifier loads, use active filtering that also compensates.
map.⚠ 需满足 0 < 有功功率 P ≤ 视在功率 S；有功不可能大于视在。: ⚠ Requires 0 < active power P ≤ apparent power S; active power cannot exceed apparent power.
